Commentary.Commentary: Welcome back! The players are back on the field. Jason Holder is opening today, along with Shamarh Brooks. It's going to be Axar Patel to bowl the first over. Here we go...
... CHASE TIME ...
It's a big total for an insipid and inconsistent batting department of West Indies. Can they overhaul the target? Stay tuned to find out...

Shreyas Iyer (64) comes up for an interview. Says that you need to be flexible and be ready to make use of the opportunities. He is glad to accept the challenge to open and it came off well. Praises Deepak Hooda for showing the right intent and adds that runs coming from both ends helped him. Shares that they were looking for a total of 180 as the wicket gets slow in the second innings. He feels that they have got an over-par total. Shreyas is confident about his bowlers to defend this total.

There was a slight break due to lightning nearby the stadium. It disturbed India's momentum slightly as they managed only 47 runs for the loss of 4 wickets in the last five overs. It was yet another lacklustre bowling show by West Indies as a group. They are just not looking ready to take on a top team. There were so many boundary balls served and the Indian batters had no qualms in putting them away.

It was a thunderous batting show by India, especially in the first 15 overs! Right from the start, they batted in top gear and focused on getting at least one boundary from every over. The run rate was very impressive and credit must go to Shreyas Iyer and Deepak Hooda for their brilliant knocks and quickfire partnership.

A terrific last over and West Indies have stopped India from getting close to 200. Odean Smith, usually known for leaking runs, bowled three brilliant overs at the death and his efforts restricted India's charge.
Short and around off, no pace on offer, Khan hits it towards point and picks up a run. India finish on 188 for 7.
A brilliant yorker, around leg, Avesh tries to dig it out misses.
Avesh Khan is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! A miscued shot from Axar and he is gone. Full toss wide outside off, Patel has to fetch it as he attempts to heave it over the leg side. Ends up slicing it to point where Pooran takes a simple catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Nicholas Pooran b Odean Smith

Commentary.Commentary: Too full in length around off, Patel drills it down to long off and turns down the single.
SIX! Out of here! Back of a length, around off, Axar gives it the full whack of his bat and launches it over long on for a biggie. Smashed with the wind, that's the key.
Kuldeep Yadav is the new batter.

OUT! RUN OUT! Hardik Pandya is gone. Fuller in length and wide outside off, Axar drags it back off the inner half. Odean jumps and collects the ball. He scores a direct hit immediately at the bowler's end. The ball deflects and the batters cross. It's referred upstairs. The replays find that Pandya is short of his crease.
Fullish and on middle, Axar knocks it down to long on for a run. So make it a 19-run penultimate over.
Very full and around off, Hardik mistimes his flick to deep mid-wicket. Only a run but he will retain strike. Hang on, there is a late call for a no ball. Holder has overstepped. Free Hit loading...

FOUR! Stand and delivery. Hitting with the wind. Two dots followed by 16 runs off three balls. Pandya showing his class. A low full toss, around off, Pandya whips it across the line and dispatches it over deep mid-wicket.
FOUR! Another poor execution of yorker. A full toss down the leg side, Hardik shuffles across and spanks it down to fine leg for a boundary.
SIX! A lot of bottom hand on that shot! Holder misses his yorker this time, it turns out to be a full ball in the slot and Pandya clobbers it over long on for a biggie.
Two dots now. A wide yorker again, outside off, Pandya squeezes it out but straight to point.
Holder nails his yorker wide outside off, Hardik digs it out to the off side.
Jason Holder comes back into the attack.
Slightly short and on middle, Hardik turns it in the gap at mid-wicket and keeps strike. Yet another brilliant over by Odean Smith. It's a rarity, if you know what we mean!
Width there outside off, short in length, Axar forces it to sweeper cover for one.
Back of a length, around middle, Pandya punches it down to long on for one.
Fuller in length and outside off, driven through covers for a run.
Axar Patel is the new batter.

OUT! Given lbw! Dinesh Karthik has referred the decision. Coming to the delivery, it's a dipping full toss, around leg, Dinesh Karthik tries to play the reverse-batted shot but fails to connect. It hits him on the back boot and they appeal. The finger goes up. DRS time. No edge is found on the UltraEdge. Ball Tracking takes time to load but once it loads, it shows that everything is in line. Three reds and DK is on his bike.
Wide! Short but down the leg side, DK tries to pull but misses.
Shortish and on middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Similar to the last delivery. Wide and outside off, Dinesh Karthik shuffles across the stumps and then leaves. The umpire doesn't call for a wide.
A low full toss wide outside off, Dinesh Karthik looks to play at it but misses.
On off and slightly shorter in length, Dinesh Karthik knocks it to wide long on for a brace.
FOUR! Nailed! Too full in length and around off, Karthik forces his drive straight down the ground and finds the fence. DK is up and running with two boundaries.
Full toss outside off, Dinesh Karthik throws his bat to slap it but doesn't connect well. The ball rolls towards the fielder at short third man.
FOUR! Shot! Dinesh Karthik goes down and across, fetches a length ball from outside off and sweeps it behind square leg for a boundary. DK knows his angles!
Dominic Drakes comes back into the attack. 1 for 14 in his 2 overs so far.
On off and on a good length, Dinesh Karthik punches it to long on for a single. Just 5 from the over, along with a wicket.
On a length and on leg, Hardik Pandya flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Slightly shorter on off, Hardik Pandya defends it towards the mid off region.
Bowls it outside leg, Hardik Pandya looks to flick it but misses. Wide called.
Slightly shorter and on leg, Karthik gently flicks it towards square leg for one.
Dinesh Karthik arrives. He can be lethal in the end overs.

OUT! Off stump goes for a walk! Back of a length, around off and angling in, Samson stays deep inside the crease and tries to punch it through the line. He though gets cramped for room and ends up deflecting his shot on the off stump. It goes cartwheeling out of the ground and India lose their fourth wicket.
On a length and on off, Pandya punches it to long on. They collect one.
Fuller and outside off, Sanju Samson drives it to deep covers for a brace.
Dinesh Karthik arrives.
Odean Smith to bowl now. Also, Jason Holder has gone off the field to get his ankle treated.
FOUR! Put away this time! Full in length and outside off, Samson drills another drive and this time sends it racing away to the long off fence.
Ouch, that would have hurt! Too full in length and on off, Samson drills his drive back towards the bowler. Holder tries to stop it with his boot but hurts his ankle in the process.
We're hearing from the studios that the match is about to get underway again. The players have returned. Jason Holder is getting ready to complete his over...

Update 9.10 pm IST (3.40 pm GMT) - Stoppage in play! It's bright and sunny at the moment, but there was lightning nearby. This is a precautionary measure. The players are leaving the ground. Let's hope that the action resumes soon.
This one lands outside off, Hardik Pandya steers it towards deep cover for one.
Fuller again, Hardik Pandya plays it towards the fielder at point.
Goes fuller and on off, Sanju Samson drives it to deep extra cover for a single.
Slightly shorter one, Sanju Samson gently flicks it to deep square leg. They collect one.
FOUR! This is abysmal bowling. Short again, an attempted leg spinner, around leg, Samson latches onto it and smashes it through square leg for a boundary.
A low full toss, Hardik Pandya hits it to long on for one.
FOUR! Hit-me delivery! Short and down the leg side, Hardik Pandya turns inside the crease and pulls it with ease, wide of short fine leg for a boundary. The Indian skipper opens his account.
Outside off this time, Sanju Samson pushes it to through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller one on off, Sanju Samson eases it back towards the left side of the bowler.
Hardik Pandya arrives to a huge ovation from the crowd.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Both the set batters are dismissed and West Indies are staging a fightback. Jason Holder speeds in from 'round the wicket and tries to bowl a slower-ball yorker. The execution though is not there and it turns out to be a low full toss outside off. Shreyas Iyer tries to fetch it from there and tonk it over the leg side but the ball takes the toe end of the bat and lobs back to the bowler. Holder takes the return catch gleefully and ends Shreyas' stay at the crease.
Yorker and outside off, Shreyas Iyer looks to play at it but misses.
On a shortish length and on off, Sanju Samson lofts it but gets the timing wrong. It goes in the air and falls short of the fielder at long on. They collect one.
Slightly shorter one, Shreyas Iyer looks to pull it but doesn't connect well. The ball goes towards the mid-wicket fielder. They collect one.
Yorker and outside off, Shreyas Iyer looks to play at it but misses.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Holder begins his second spell with a full toss outside off, Shreyas Iyer reaches out and strokes it past the diving cover-point fielder for a boundary.
Jason Holder returns in the attack. His only over went for 5 runs.
Outside off this time, Shreyas Iyer guides it to deep extra cover and takes one. 4 runs and a big wicket in the over.
Fuller and on middle, Sanju Samson dances down the track for a big hit but doesn't connect well. The ball goes towards the long on region. They collect one run.
Sanju Samson walks in next.

OUT! Hooda holes out! He attempts a lofted shot against the breeze and the ball holds up quite a bit in the air. The change of ends has worked for Hayden Walsh. He serves it flat and outside leg, Deepak Hooda skips down the track, makes room and tries to heave it across the line. The ball comes from the inner half of his bat and flies to deep mid-wicket. Shamarh Brooks settles underneath it and West Indies break the dangerous 76-run stand.
Commentary.Howout: c Shamarh Brooks b Hayden Walsh

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up delivery, Iyer looks for a big hit but the ball comes from the inside half of the bat and goes towards deep mid-wicket. They cross.
Tossed up, on off, Shreyas Iyer shuffles across for a reverse sweep but misses and falls. He gets a lucky escape as the ball didn't hit the stumps.
Fuller and around leg, Deepak Hooda steps back and gently pushes it to deep extra cover for one.
Change in bowling. Hayden Walsh gets back into the attack. He has changed ends now. 18 from his 2 overs so far.
Touch fuller, outside off, Deepak Hooda drills it to long on for one more. 17 from the over!
Bowls it fuller, Shreyas Iyer lofts it. The ball goes in the air and falls just short of Jason Holder at long on. The batters cross.
FOUR! Another boundary square of the wicket on the off side for Shreyas. A length ball outside off, angling away, Shreyas throws his bat at it and slices it behind backward point for a boundary.
Fuller and down the leg side, Deepak Hooda gently guides it towards long on and rotates the strike.
SIX! Hooda goes downtown this time! Fuller in length and outside off, Hooda shuffles across the stumps to get close to the delivery and towers it behind the bowler's head for a biggie. 100 comes up!

FOUR! That's a scintillating shot! A touch short in length and outside off, Hooda stays deep inside the crease, uses his wrists and muscles it over square leg for a boundary. This is the reason he is rated so highly by the team management.

Drinks break. India are off to a flying start despite losing Ishan Kishan early. The pair of Shreyas Iyer and Deepak Hooda is looking in fine form and the visitors are motoring at the halfway stage. 200 will be on India's radar from here on and West Indies will have to bowl well to limit the damage. Obed McCoy to bowl after the mini-break...

FOUR! West Indies continue to leak at least one boundary every over. Width there outside off, short in length, Shreyas smacks it over point for a boundary. Fifty for Shreyas Iyer, off 30 balls and he will be eyeing a century with 10 overs remaining.
This one lands outside leg, Shreyas Iyer leaves it alone. Wide called.
Fuller and on off, Deepak Hooda flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker one, following the batter down the leg side, Hooda tries to heave but misses. It's a good take by Thomas and he appeals for a catch. The umpire gestures that it brushed the pads.
Delivers it outside off, Shreyas Iyer lofts it. The ball goes in the air and lands safely just before the long on fielder. They cross.
Goes fuller this time, Deepak Hooda gently flicks it towards square leg for one. The 50-run stand comes up, off 31 balls.
On a length, outside off, this is played towards long off for one run.
Rovman Powell replaces Odean Smith in the attack.
Fuller one, on middle, Iyer hits it to long on for a single.
Tossed up, on off, Deepak Hooda tucks it to square leg for one.
Outside off, and fuller in length, Iyer eases it to covers for one.
Tossed up, on middle, Deepak Hooda flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Goes 'round the wicket and bowls it flat and outside off, Hooda tries to drive but fails to connect.
SIX! Hooda shows his class now! Floated and full, outside off, Deepak skips down the track and lofts it nonchalantly over extra cover for a maximum.
SIX! This is a shot of absolute class! Smith delivers it on a length and outside off, Shreyas dispatches it over long off for a biggie. Not an easy shot to play. 15 from the over!
SIX! Over the top! Odean Smith delivers it short and outside off, Shreyas exercises his arms, steps back to make room and slams it over point for a biggie.
Outside off and on a good length, Deepak Hooda steers it with soft hands towards backward point and rotates the strike.
On a length and on middle, Shreyas Iyer flicks it from the inside half of the bat towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Fuller again, outside off, Shreyas Iyer eases it towards the cover fielder.
Odean Smith starts with a fuller one around middle and leg, Deepak Hooda flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Change in bowling. Odean Smith is given the ball now.
Tossed up, around off, Deepak Hooda guides it towards deep cover. They cross.
Outside off, this is eased to sweeper cover for a single.
Goes fuller again, Deepak Hooda eases it to long on for one more.
Fuller one this time, Shreyas Iyer works it towards long on for one.
Tossed up outside off, short in length again, Shreyas Iyer looks to repeat the last shot but fails to connect this time.
FOUR! Put away! Walsh starts with a long hop, wide outside off, Shreyas rocks back and whacks it through backward point for a boundary.
Hayden Walsh to bowl for the first time in this series.
Fractionally short and on middle, Shreyas tucks it through mid-wicket for one. At the end of the Powerplay, India are 53 for 1.
Full in length and outside off, Hooda plays a mistimed shot back towards the bowler. Very casual from Paul in his followthrough as he lets the ball go through. The batters steal a run.
Wide! Sliding down the leg side, the batter leaves it.
FOUR! Hooda continues to impress! Short in length, around middle, Deepak Hooda hangs on the back foot and at the last moment, he ramps it behind the keeper for a boundary. 50 comes up for India.
On middle, worked to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Short and on off, the bounce gets big on the batter, Hooda plays a mistimed pull shot wide of mid on for a run.

FOUR! What a shot! A length ball, around middle, Hooda presents a straight bat and with a lovely extension of his arms, he puts it away behind the bowler for a boundary. Quality. It's a no ball also for overstepping. Free Hit time...
Finds the fielder. Short and outside off, slower in pace, Hooda cracks it off the back foot but finds the fielder at cover-point.

Slower one, on a length and around off, Hooda bunts it towards mid on and sets off for a run. Shreyas is ball-watching for a moment but then rushes across. The fielder fumbles and makes the single easy. Excellent over from Dominic Drakes, only 2 runs from it along with a wicket.
Short in length and outside off, leaving the batter with the angle, Hooda punches it from the back foot but finds point.
On a length and around leg, Hooda fails to flick and it goes off his pads to mid-wicket.
Deepak Hooda is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Drakes strikes. Digs it in a short delivery, around off, Ishan Kishan rocks back to pull it across the line but the bounce gets big on his blade and he ends up getting a top edge. The ball flies to mid on where Nicholas Pooran runs back a bit and takes the skier safely. A breakthrough for West Indies against the run of play.
Commentary.Howout: c Nicholas Pooran b Dominic Drakes

Commentary.Commentary: Around off, short in length, Ishan dabs it down to point.
Slower delivery, full and around off, Shreyas flicks it a bit aerially but through the gap at mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish and on off, turned wide of mid on for a single. 10 from this over!

NOT OUT! Back of a length, around middle, Shreyas works it gently through mid-wicket and straightaway calls for two. The fielder attacks the ball in the deep and fires the throw to the bowler. Keemo collects it in front of the stumps and then breaks them. He appeals, the umpire takes it upstairs and the replays find Kishan safe.
Appeal for a run out...
Slower delivery, short and around off, Shreyas is early into the shot and misses.
FOUR! Streaky! Full and wide outside off, Shreyas throws his bat at it and the ball flies off the outside edge to third man. A bonus boundary for India.
Shortish and around off, Ishan chops it down square of the wicket on the off side and takes a quick run. It's called a no ball. Free Hit coming up...
In the zone outside off, on a length, Kishan pushes it off the front foot to covers.

Lazy from the bowler. Keemo serves it on a length around off, stopping a bit onto the batter, Shreyas tries to work it on the leg side but it takes the outer half and the ball rolls back towards the bowler. Paul doesn't bend down to pick it up and lets it roll to mid off. Shreyas spots the chance for a run and pinches it easily.
Keemo Paul comes into the attack now.
Beautifully timed. Fuller in length and outside off, no pace on offer, Kishan drives it past the diving cover fielder. It's stopped in the deep and they get two runs. 12 from the over!
Back of a length, around leg, Shreyas glances it off his hips, not timed perfectly but it goes in the gap at square leg. They cross.
Another punch from the back foot by Iyer but this time he finds the cover fielder inside the ring.
FOUR! Delightful! This is very good from Shreyas Iyer. Back of a length, around off, Iyer stays tall inside the crease and packs a punch through covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Not from the middle of the bat but it still races away. Fuller in length and outside off, slower in pace, Iyer tries to heave but gets an inside edge and it goes to the deep mid-wicket fence.
Drakes begins with a short ball around off, Ishan plays it down softly to point and scampers across to the other end.
Dominic Drakes comes into the attack.
Slower again, on a length and angling in around off, Ishan pushes it gently through point and retains strike with a single.
Wide again, third of the over. Obed tries to bowl a slower one but delivers it way wide outside off. Ishan chases but misses.
Gets away with a bad ball. Full and around leg, Kishan helps it off his pads but finds short fine leg. Either side of that fielder and it would have been a boundary.
Wide! Obed McCoy loses his radar and sprays a short ball way wide outside off. The batter leaves again.
Full and around middle, it's clipped to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short and wide outside off, slapped over point. There is a protection in the deep and hence only a run.

FOUR! Perfectly placed. Width there outside off, short in length, Ishan Kishan stays back calmly and opens the face of his bat at the last moment to guide it through the gap between short third man and backward point.
Slightly short and outside off, Ishan stays back and plays it down to point.
Wide! McCoy begins with a length delivery but it's too wide outside off, Kishan leaves.
Obed McCoy to bowl from the other end.

Chance of a run, missed! Slower one, a length ball around off, Shreyas taps it down to point and sets off for a run. He is sent back but has nowhere to go. Luckily for him, the fielder (Shimron Hetmyer) misses his shy at the striker's end and Iyer survives. The replays show that Ishan Kishan had responded initially before sending Iyer back.
FOUR! Up and over! Shreyas opens his account with a boundary. A length delivery, around off, Iyer finds it in his range and powers it over mid on for a boundary.
A touch short in length and close to off, Iyer pushes it from the back foot to covers. Not in the gap.
Movement on this delivery. Holder delivers an outswinger, on a length outside off, Shreyas allows it through.
India are away! Too full in length and more in the line of the stumps, Kishan drives it down the ground, to the left of mid off and takes a single.
Good shot, but not in the gap. Full in length and outside off, Kishan is on the front foot as he drives but finds mid off.

Time to get underway! The men concerned are out in the middle. Ishan Kishan and Shreyas Iyer have come out to open for India. It's going to be Jason Holder to bowl the first over. All in readiness, the players take the knee to show their support for the Black Lives Matter movement and here we go...

Nicholas Pooran, the skipper of West Indies, says that he would have batted first but now they will try to restrict India to a gettable total. Informs that West Indies have also made four changes. Tells that for them it's all about getting the experience and getting better with every game. On Hayden Walsh playing today and not before, Pooran replies that it was tactical and it's nice to have both Akeal Hosein and Walsh in the squad.

Hardik Pandya, the stand-in captain of India, says that in the second innings the wicket got slower in the last match, so they want to bat first when the pitch is fresh. Adds that the crowd has been very supportive and hopes to entertain them. Mentions that they have set some standards and need to make sure they go out and show their skills. Tells that as a team, they are relaxed and the boys are told to play their natural game. Four changes - informs Hardik Pandya.

West Indies (Playing XI) - Shamarh Brooks (In for Brandon King), Devon Thomas (WK), Nicholas Pooran (C), Rovman Powell, Shimron Hetmyer, Jason Holder, Odean Smith (In for Alzarri Joseph), Keemo Paul (In for Kyle Mayers), Hayden Walsh (In for Akeal Hosein), Dominic Drakes, Obed McCoy.

India (Playing XI) - Ishan Kishan (In for Rohit Sharma), Shreyas Iyer (In for Rishabh Pant), Sanju Samson, Hardik Pandya (C) (In for Suryakumar Yadav), Deepak Hooda, Dinesh Karthik (WK), Axar Patel, Kuldeep Yadav (In for Bhuvneshwar Kumar), Avesh Khan, Ravi Bishnoi, Arshdeep Singh.
Toss - The two captains have come out and it's not Rohit Sharma but Hardik Pandya leading the Men in Blue in this match. Up goes the coin, Pandya calls correctly and INDIA ELECT TO  BAT FIRST!
